description: Remove Exqlite, sqlite3 integration, and native SQLite packaging. Add bedrock from its GitHub repository and persist workflow run and step state in a repository-local Bedrock cluster under .hancho.

comments.text: Replaced Exqlite and SQLite packaging with a repository-local Bedrock cluster in .hancho/bedrock. Added transactional run and step storage, an explicit durability flush, cross-process persistence coverage, and a built-escript reopen test. mix check passes: 68 tests and 78.32% coverage.

title: Replace SQLite with Bedrock state storage
